node_hits.rationale: Walkthrough of consolidation: central data collection, automated intercompany eliminations, manual topside entries, centralized corporate review.

evidence.quote: each entity submits its reconciliations into the consolidation system. We collect data from every ledger and load it centrally before we run eliminations.
evidence.note: Central data collection into the consolidation system (verbal).

evidence.quote: The consolidation tool runs the intercompany eliminations automatically based on matched IC accounts. It's a fairly mature, machine-driven step.
evidence.note: Automated intercompany eliminations; manual topside entries.

evidence.quote: Consolidation is fully centralized at corporate. Regions feed data in, but the actual consolidation and corporate review happen in one central team.

lens_signals.rationale: A consolidation process exists and runs each close.
Mature, machine-driven elimination step is a relative strength.
Intercompany eliminations run automatically in the consolidation tool.
Consolidation and corporate review are fully centralized.

candidate_findings.observation: Topside entries are still booked manually by corporate while eliminations are automated.
candidate_findings.recommended_action: Templatize/automate recurring topside entries to match the maturity of the elimination step.

node_hits.rationale: Reconciliations (an Account Reconciliations close activity) are described as a relative strength.

evidence.quote: Reconciliations are actually one of our stronger areas. The recon tool is standardized, every account has an owner, and aging items get escalated.
evidence.note: Standardized recon tool with ownership and escalation (verbal).
